industry_name: US adult vocational and continuing-education providers
jurisdiction: United States research pilot; provider, funder, state workforce and program-specific reporting requirements require authorized review.
source_frame: Action Model system-map industry slug education_training; taxonomy reference only, not demand, eligibility or implementation proof.
scope_note: Covers administrative workflows for adult vocational, workforce and continuing education providers. It excludes child data, admissions or credential decisions, professional-licensing decisions, grading authority and claims about learner outcomes.
summary: Start with supervised learner intake, cohort logistics, attendance/progress evidence and completion-report preparation. Keep the provider's learning, student and reporting systems authoritative until a pilot proves record accuracy, privacy, accessibility and lower reviewed effort. No adoption, price, savings or outcome forecast is used.

automation_research.finding: US Department of Labor guidance describes workforce and apprenticeship programs with participant, training and completion/reporting responsibilities. That grounds an inventory of intake, scheduling, attendance and evidence-preservation work, but does not establish an automation rate; eligibility, admissions, credential and licensing decisions remain authorized human work.
automation_research.forecast_note: Program guidance is not an automation, adoption or savings forecast; no independently verified percentage is used.

modules.capability: Upstream project presents a learning-management application with course, enrollment and learning-progress workflows.
modules.reuse_shape: Read-oriented course/enrollment sidecar or controlled pilot against synthetic records; preserve the provider's system of record and approval boundaries.
modules.rights_state: Coverage inventory records AGPL-3.0; edition, dependencies, deployment and rights obligations require review.
modules.limits: Project documentation and repository presence do not prove accessibility, privacy, integrations, reporting correctness, support or production fitness.

modules.capability: Upstream project provides a web-conferencing system useful for supervised live classes and session records.
modules.reuse_shape: Optional live-session link and attendance-evidence adapter; do not infer participation, mastery or completion from connection events alone.
modules.rights_state: Upstream license, hosting, recording and data-retention route require review before reuse.
modules.limits: Conference capability is not evidence of instructional quality, learner identity, attendance validity, accessibility or credential authority.

modules.capability: Upstream project describes visual automation, connectors and workflow execution useful for approved reminders and status synchronization.
modules.reuse_shape: Allowlisted, idempotent notifications and record-routing sidecar with human approval before external writes; never an admissions, eligibility, grading or credential-decision engine.
modules.rights_state: Existing value-matrix route is community-core/service-oriented; edition, license, connectors and deployment obligations require review.
modules.limits: Connector availability does not prove learner consent, permissioning, retry safety, privacy, accessibility or reporting compliance.

processes.process: Adult learner or employer-sponsored training intake and record completeness review
processes.automation_boundary: Normalize supplied contact, cohort, prerequisite and consent fields; detect missing or duplicate records; do not decide admission, eligibility, accommodation, funding or licensing status.
processes.baseline_required: Matched intake volume, completeness and duplicate rate, human review/chase/rework minutes, privacy incidents and actual operating spend.
processes.metric: Net human minutes per complete, authorized intake record including exceptions and rework
processes.falsifier: Reject if unauthorized fields are collected, records are merged incorrectly, protected information crosses a permission boundary, or total reviewed effort is not reduced.
processes.human_authority: Provider-designated admissions or program staff control intake policy, eligibility, accommodations, consent and any funding decision.

processes.process: Cohort, instructor and live-session logistics coordination
processes.automation_boundary: Draft schedules, reminders and approved roster changes from current records; flag conflicts; do not assign a learner to a regulated pathway or promise a seat, accommodation or credential.
processes.baseline_required: Matched cohort/session volume, schedule and roster error rate, reminder retries, human review/rework time and actual spend.
processes.metric: Net human minutes per accurate, approved session change; roster, duplicate-send and missed-session exceptions
processes.falsifier: Reject if a stale or wrong-recipient reminder is sent, a roster change is unauthorized, accessibility or accommodation needs are lost, or review/rework offsets the effort reduction.
processes.human_authority: Program and instructor owners approve schedules, rosters, accommodations, cancellations and learner communications.

processes.process: Attendance and learner-progress evidence collection and exception review
processes.automation_boundary: Collect attendance or activity events and surface missing, conflicting or late evidence with provenance; do not infer mastery, make a grade or treat a connection event as completion.
processes.baseline_required: Matched learner/session volume, evidence completeness and correction rate, reviewer/rework minutes, access incidents and operating cost.
processes.metric: Review minutes per accepted evidence packet; missing/incorrect event rate and unresolved exceptions
processes.falsifier: Reject if attendance is falsely asserted, evidence provenance is lost, critical exceptions rise, or a system event is used as a grading, completion or credential decision without authorized review.
processes.human_authority: Instructor or designated program staff validate attendance/progress evidence and retain grading, completion and accommodation authority.

processes.automation_boundary: Assemble approved attendance, progress and completion fields into a reviewable report with source links; do not award a credential, determine eligibility, certify a licensure requirement or submit without authorized sign-off.
processes.baseline_required: Matched reporting units, field completeness and correction/rejection rate, human review/rework minutes, submission incidents and actual spend.
processes.metric: Net human minutes per accurate, approved report; correction, rejection, late and unauthorized-submission rate
processes.falsifier: Reject if unsupported completion or eligibility appears in a report, an unauthorized submission occurs, material corrections increase, or review/rework removes the effort reduction.
processes.human_authority: Authorized provider/funder reporting owner approves completion, eligibility, credential and submission decisions.

observed_business_value.reason: No provider baseline, achieved automation rate, review/rework data, operating cost, avoided spend or eligible-population measurement. Null is not zero.

pilot.design: Within one authorized provider, compare matched redacted or synthetic cohorts and reporting periods under the incumbent and supervised candidate workflows; pre-register permitted fields, approval points and retention rules.
reject_if: Human time including review/rework is not lower than matched baseline.
Any learner record crosses an unauthorized boundary or an unapproved external send/submission occurs.
Attendance, progress, completion, eligibility, credential or licensing authority is inferred from an automation event without authorized review.
Measured first-year net cash is not positive for a cash-savings offer; capacity gains alone are not cash.

limitations: This is not admissions, credentialing, licensing, education, legal or workforce-program advice, product admission or an industry-wide forecast.
Child data is out of scope; adult-provider systems may still contain sensitive learner information requiring data minimization and access controls.
Current software adoption prevalence, prices, learner outcomes, accessibility and security were not verified; named offerings are not assumed installed.

No generic repository is claimed to replace a provider's student, learning, reporting or professional-authority systems; rights, privacy, retention, accessibility, restoration and jurisdiction-specific requirements remain product-owner gates.
